description: On the table in front of you are a wooden slotted plank, a couple of black wheels with yellow centers, a threaded wooden peg, and a small red piece. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up the threaded peg, brings it toward a wheel, and uses both hands as a two-hand object to press and twist the wheel onto the peg; then both hands lower the partly assembled piece onto the plank and keep turning and tightening the peg in place before the hands release and move back.
